metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a runnable Python 3.11+ iCalendar tool (stdlib-only) under `output/` with the required CLI and JSON schemas.

- Entry point: `output/main.py`
- Commands:
  - `python output/main.py parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `python output/main.py expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`
- Core modules:
  - `output/ical/parse.py` (VCALENDAR + VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VAVAILABILITY + VALARM; raw_properties; warnings)
  - `output/ical/rrule.py` (RRULE parsing + Gregorian expansion)
  - `output/ical/tz.py` (VTIMEZONE-based local→UTC conversion with fold/gap warnings)
  - `output/ical/expand.py` (window expansion, EXDATE/RDATE, basic overrides via RECURRENCE-ID, sorting contract)
  - `output/ical/lex.py` (unfolding, parameter parsing with RFC 6868 decoding, TEXT unescaping, line length warnings)
